propositions: Configuration must resolve once per operation boundary with immutable, serializable OperationSnapshot following explicit input > environment > project config > user config > schema default precedence, without rereading ambient state mid-operation.

Provider-native authentication (LLM, Git, bridge, MCP, review-bot, op-cert) must compose consistently through operation-scoped bindings without credential store, credential mutation of global os.environ, or unauthorized fallback to anonymous/alternate principals.

Static credentials must be represented with provider-specific non-serializable Pydantic carriers, revealed only in sending adapters, and never appear in repr, serialization, logs, exceptions, or subprocess environments.

Op-cert must accept exactly one of REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY, validate before service work, store in process-owned 0700/0600 copy, and observe changes only after restart without runtime SSM/boto3 coupling.

Same-capability children inherit ambient environment for Git/SSH/AWS/proxy/CA; owning children receive adapter overlay; unrelated sibling children must remove exact secret names declared by other Rebar adapters.

AST ownership gate must derive config/credential names from authoritative registries, reject direct/aliased loads and reads below approved seams, permit only exact path/symbol+rationale exceptions, and reach zero legacy exceptions at cutover.
